basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the bustling city of Chicago, PokeMaster_78 is a 32-year-old software engineer with a penchant for adventure. A longtime Pokémon enthusiast, they spend weekends exploring the city's parks and landmarks while capturing rare Pokémon. When not immersed in the digital world, they enjoy reading about humanoid encounters and indulging in the occasional sci-fi novel. In a committed relationship, they often team up with their partner for raids. Typically online during evening hours, they balance their time between work and their passion for all things Pokémon. While they love discussing their hobbies, they have little patience for misinformation or negativity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Illinois, PokeMaster_78 has spent the last decade honing their skills in software development. Their journey into the world of Pokémon started in childhood, evolving into a serious hobby with the release of Pokémon GO. Self-taught in game strategies and community engagement, they have become a go-to resource for raid tactics and Pokémon lore.
